The image shows a mango leaf with dark black, soot-like speckles and patches scattered across the surface. There are no sunken lesions, no powdery white coating, and no signs of twig dieback. The dark superficial encrustations on the leaf surface match Sooty Mould precisely — black fungal mycelium growing on honeydew secretions, not penetrating the leaf tissue.
